checks.claim: Wave 15 closure was NOT fabricated — 44C/6P in bundle is an honest gap

checks.evidence: Bundle was frozen at feat commit 2dddb28 before Lane I (LI-04..09) completed. Disk has 50/50 COMPLETE (written in subsequent chore commits bf2d101 + 79e7136). This is exactly the protocol v1.1 structural gap that protocol v2 was designed to fix. Not fabrication — timing gap.

checks.claim: No secret files (.pfx/.pem/.key) staged or committed
checks.attack: Is test-cert.pfx staged or will it sneak into the evidence bundle?
checks.evidence: test-cert.pfx is untracked only (not staged). .gitignore updated with *.pfx, *.pem, *.key, *.p12 patterns. Bundle script uses include-list (not glob-all) so test-cert.pfx will not be included. SHV-01 rule would catch any staging attempt.

checks.claim: Evidence Authority Protocol v2 fixes the ZIP-contains-own-SHA flaw
checks.attack: Does the new protocol actually prevent a SHA from appearing inside its own bundle?
checks.evidence: protocol-v2.md defines two-phase model: Phase 1 freezes bundle with PRE_BUNDLE_CLOSEOUT (no SHA claim); Phase 2 creates external .sha256 sidecar and final-attestation.json AFTER freeze. EAV-05 validator enforces that inside-bundle closeout does not claim final SHA. This is structurally different from v1.1 where closeout was inside bundle with SHA.
